5.5 Data Types on Service Interface level
The following chapter describes the C++ language mapping in
ara::com
of the
SI
specific ("user defined") data types. "user defined" here means, that those data types
aren’t defined/mandated by
ara::com
API itself like e.g.
InstanceIdentifier
,
FindServiceHandle
,
ServiceHandleContainer
or any other data type defined
by
ara::com
in its own namespace, but are specifically provided by the user defined
SI
description (IDL).
